boundary: This proves an exact one-branch relationship and a spectral separation theorem, incorporating Pass 676 rather than treating its cyclotomic correction as a contradiction. It does not rule out a different W33 correspondence module, outside the signed-turn edge-chain complex, containing both flat-block branches and their rank-four q-primary interface.

chain_operator.H1_identification: H1 is exactly the K=-6 eigenspace
chain_operator.operator: K=R^T(T-O)R on the 240 integral edge chains

flatblock_specialization.missing_branch: M_6 would require K=0, but K is invertible
flatblock_specialization.mod3_behavior: the roots 0 and 6 coalesce modulo 3, but the integral chain representation still contains only the zero branch

pass676_real_cyclotomic_correction.interpretation: The abstract Z/3 cross-Ext is only the rank-one q-adic shadow. The real cyclotomic flat block has a four-dimensional 3-primary interface, but none of it is internal to the one-branch H1 eigenspace.

module_level_conclusion.commutant_consistency: Because every polynomial in K acts scalarly on the single H1 eigenspace, this branch specialization is consistent with Pass 671 scalar commutant rigidity.
module_level_conclusion.relationship: The W33 H1 lattice is a canonical one-branch specialization of the q=3 flat-block operator under S=K+6I.
module_level_conclusion.separation: No M6 companion occurs anywhere in the signed-turn edge-chain spectrum. Therefore neither the abstract rank-one Z/3 cross-branch class nor the corrected four-dimensional 3-primary cyclotomic gluing interface of Pass 676 can be realized internally as a self-extension of H1.

theorem: At q=3 the abstract flat-block order is Z_3[S]/(S(S-6)), while the real cyclotomic two-branch substrate has gluing factors (Z/6)^2+(Z/3)^2 and 3-primary rank four. Nevertheless, the W33 signed-turn chain operator K has spectrum -6^81, 2^120, 4^24, 10^15, and H1 is exactly its -6 eigenspace. Therefore S=K+6I acts identically as zero on H1, making the 81-dimensional homology lattice a canonical realization of the M0 branch. The M6 branch would require a K=0 eigenspace, but K is invertible, so it is absent. Consequently both the abstract Z/3 shadow and the real cyclotomic rank-four gluing belong to larger two-branch modules that the W33 signed-turn chain does not contain.
